summary: A local organizer starts learning the county organizations while the candidate is still deciding whether to enter.
realLife: Reese had assessed West Virginia counties before O’Brien arrived, Vogelsinger recalled.
gates: Entry into the primary is under consideration.
inGame: needs: exploratory work dated before a candidate's filing and a record of who undertook it.

turns.what: The organizer waits for the candidate's decision before taking on county work.
turns.pulledBy: The organizer already owes time to another commitment.
turns.writesBack: The first county assignment begins after entry.

turns.what: The organizer gathers public meeting dates and holds off on calling local officers.
turns.pulledBy: The candidate has authorized an initial look only.
turns.writesBack: The exploratory file contains a calendar with no commitments.
